alt: 畫展牆上一排排圖畫全是相同位置的紅太陽、綠樹與小屋，毫無變化，孩子看著重複的作品露出無聊神情。
scene_prompt: 千篇一律 means monotonously identical forms without variation, not admirable tidiness. Modern school art exhibition wall: a large grid of many separate student paintings ALL look exactly the same, each has the same red round sun in top left, the same green triangular tree in middle and the same tiny brown square house in lower right, same composition and colors repeated across every sheet with no creative difference. Two children in foreground look bored and disappointed as they scan row after row of identical pictures; one child holds an unused paintbrush and looks at the repetitive display wondering what to create. Make the mechanical sameness and dullness unmistakable while preserving hand-made pencil and watercolor texture, not a digital pattern. No labels, names, writing or numbers on the papers or wall, no captions or speech bubbles. Two anatomically coherent children only, natural hands and postures, pictures physically attached flat to wall, clean uncluttered classroom.
